# Rizeon AI

> Rizeon AI is an AI consultancy based in Singapore that builds AI infrastructure for professional service firms. We automate the repetitive operations that cost owners the most time and revenue: lead response and qualification, client communication and follow-up, and admin and data operations.

## What we do

- Document Chasing & Collection: client paperwork chased, collected and organised automatically, with persistent polite follow-up until every document is in. This is the highest-impact automation for most professional service firms.
- Lead Response & Qualification: every enquiry answered in under a minute, qualified against the firm's criteria, and booked directly into the calendar.
- Client Communication & Follow-up: follow-ups, reminders and status updates sent on time across WhatsApp and email, trained on the firm's tone and protocols.
- Admin & Data Operations: data entry and reporting handled automatically across CRM, calendar and inbox.
- Custom Infrastructure: bespoke AI systems architected around a firm's specific business logic.

## Who we serve

Professional service firms in Singapore: law firms, recruitment agencies, aesthetic clinics, accounting practices, property and real estate agencies, and insurance firms.

## How we work

1. Audit: workflow and response-time diagnostic, revenue-leak analysis quantified in dollars, diagnostic report, and a fixed-price build roadmap.
2. Build: custom AI infrastructure around the firm's business logic, integrated with existing CRM, calendar and WhatsApp. Sandbox tested before launch.
3. Launch: phased rollout with zero disruption, team onboarding, performance monitoring and ongoing support.

## Key facts

- Based in Singapore, founded 2025
- Deployment timeline: typically 2 to 3 weeks from audit to live
- No data migration required; systems wrap around the existing software stack
- PDPA compliant; strict AI guardrails with human escalation
- Fixed, predictable pricing; no per-message or per-user fees
